paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah;
heading: Ammon Kalh A Genkholhna

paite: "Mihing tapa, Ammon tate masuan inla, atungtang thu uh gen in.

Ammon tate kiang ah, Toupa PATHIAN thu ngaikhia unla, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: ka mun siangthou hihnit a om a, Israel gam hihgawp a a-om a, Judah Inkote sal a pi a a-om lai ua, 'Awi ing e!' na chih ziak in,
ngai in, suahlam mite kiang ah ahon tan ding un ka hon pe ding ahi; nang ah buk akoih ding ua, nang ah tenna abawl ding uh; na theigahte ane ding ua, na nawitui adawn ding uh.
Rabbah khua sangawngsau inn ding in ka bawl dia, Ammon tate mun ganhon kualna mun ding in ka bawl ding; huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding uh."
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Israel gam tung a na khut na bet a, na khe na pek a, lungsim tengteng a asiatna tung a na kipah ziak in,

ngai in, na tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, namte kiang ah gallak ding in ka hon mansak ding a; mite a kipan ka hon phuk ding a, huai gam a kipan in ka hon hihmang vengveng ding, ka hon hihse ding a, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na thei ding," chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Moab leh Seir in, ngai in, Judah inkote namdang bang ahi uh, achih ziak un.
heading: Moab Kalh A Genkholhna

paite: Moab pang khat, khopite lam pang, gamgi zul a khopi, agam thupina pente, Beth-zeshimot, Baal-meon leh Kiriathaim lam pang ka hong ding a,
suahlam tate tan ding in Ammon tate toh ka pe ding a, namte lak a Ammon tate theihgige ahih nawnlouhna ding un.
Moab gam tung ah thu gel ka tangtungsak ding a, huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih athei ding uh," chi in.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Edom in Judah inkote tung a phuba la in nakpitak in thil ahihkhial hi, amah thu kia a atung ua phu alak ziak in.
heading: Edom Kalh A Genkholhna

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Edom tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, alak ua kipan mi leh sate ka phukmang vek ding; Teman a kipan in ka hihgawp ding a; Dedan pha in namsau in asi ding uh.

Huchi in ka mi Israelte khut in ka phulakna ka tungsak ding a, Edom tung ah ka hehna bang zel leh ka thangpaihna bang zel in ahih ding ua, ka phulakna ana thei ding uh," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Philistia mite'n phu la a, tangtawn kimelmakna a, mi hihman utna lungsim sia pu a phu alak ziak un.
heading: Philistia Kalh A Genkholhna

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, ngai in, Philistia mite tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, Kareth khomite ka phuk vek ding a, tui gei a mi omsunte ka hihmang vek ding.
Huan heh mahmah in sal in atung uah phu ka la ding a, huchi a atung ua ka phulakna ka tunsak hun chiang in TOUPA ka hi chih atheita ding uh," achi hi.
